WITH overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
equip_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as equip_avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    e.equipref,
    e.equip_avg_humidity,
    o.overall_avg
  FROM equip_avg e
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats o
  WHERE e.equip_avg_humidity > o.overall_avg
    AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(equip_avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_avg
),
final_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    a.equipref,
    a.equip_avg_humidity,
    (a.equip_avg_humidity - a.overall_avg) as exceeds_overall,
    (a.equip_avg_humidity - g.group_mean) as diff_from_group_mean
  FROM above_avg a
  CROSS JOIN group_stats g
  WHERE g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  equip_avg_humidity,
  exceeds_overall,
  diff_from_group_mean
FROM final_calc
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
